# Speckit Clarify Disabled

You must not execute the standard `/speckit.clarify` behavior.

This command is disabled in the corporate MVP workflow.

## Required response

When invoked, respond:

`/speckit.clarify is disabled in the corporate MVP workflow.`

Then explain:

`Use /corp.assess to evaluate the active PBI. Functional gaps must be reviewed with the Product Owner.`

## Forbidden behavior

You must not:

- clarify functional requirements,
- resolve ambiguity on behalf of the Product Owner,
- modify the PBI,
- modify acceptance criteria,
- create or update files,
- generate planning artifacts,
- infer missing business behavior,
- call any other command automatically.
